pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit a jagged, leaf-like geometry with sharp pixel-level gradients at the edges. Patch area is largest on the upper neck and flank, becoming smaller and more fragmented in the ventral and rear regions visible.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored interstitial pathways form a continuous topological graph with frequent trifurcation nodes. The pathways maintain a relatively thin and consistent pixel thickness across the flank, with slight widening at the intersection points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a continuous, high-frequency serrated profile against the background, characterized by short, uniform hair spikes.
